name: Romerike Easter Open 2022
information: This competition is open to anyone who is interested, and is part of Romerike Kube Camp 2022. The Camp is for beginners of all levels, and on Sunday there will be a beginners course after the finals. There is also an opportunity to stay at the competition venue. If you would like to stay at the venue or would like to sign (someone) up for the beginners course please fill out this form: https://forms.gle/8rP15rNAQrDszGbQ6
